messages:
Nadia (Docs): opened a PR to refine the Nebula3b model card and update the catalog row. Changes: clearer supported-hardware matrix, callout about streaming long-context (up to 32k) w/notes on memory behavior, and replaced the old SDK snippet with a v3 streaming example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 please quick-review for anything that sounds too marketing-y.

Ravi (Runtime): Thanks. Two quick asks: add the exact runtime compatibility map (quant profile names -> runtime flavors) and mention the automatic fp16 fallback we have when specialized kernels aren't available. Otherwise customers will see 500s and open tickets.

Jun (Bench): Pasted my bench run in the PR comments: nebula3b-quant on A100: 310 tok/s (batch=1, seq=4096), on T4: 92 tok/s (batch=1, seq=4096). Suggest we present a 90% confidence range rather than exact single runs. I'll attach the bench command and docker image we used.

Ava (PM): Please avoid absolutes like "best" or "lowest latency". Add a short rollback/canary note for Dedicated customers (how to pin to the fp16 variant). Also add an explicit note about embed-vs-generate behavior (different memory paths).

Kai (DevEx): Updated the JS + Python snippets to use the new streaming client API and to show error handling for a runtime fallback. Python:
```python
from redwood import Client, RuntimeFallbackError
client = Client()
try:
  for chunk in client.generate_stream(prompt, model='nebula3b-quant'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
except RuntimeFallbackError as e:
  # fallback to fp16 variant
  for chunk in client.generate_stream(prompt, model='nebula3b-fp16'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
TS snippet in the PR too. Can someone sanity-check wording around error class names?

Nadia (Docs): CI bot flagged duplicate anchor IDs in the hardware table, and a broken internal link to /runtime/compat. Fixing anchors now and pointing to the public compat page instead.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check failed  markdown-lint: duplicate-heading-id in supported-hardware.md. See https://ci.redwood.dev/1257

Nadia (Docs): pushed fixes for anchors + updated link to runtime mapping page. Re-requesting reviews.

Ravi (Runtime): LGTM for compatibility mapping. Small nit: use the runtime name "nebula3b-q8_0" in the mapping example to match runtime labels.

Jun (Bench): added an extra note about how batching and cold starts affect the numbers; recommend adding the exact bench script in a hidden PR file for reproducibility.

Kai (DevEx): JS snippet sanity-checked and pushed. Also added a small note showing how to detect a fallback via the streaming metadata events.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check passed on second run :white_check_mark:

Ava (PM): thanks team. If all green, please merge and post a short blurb in #docs-release calling out the catalog change and the bench caveats. Nadia will include a one-line migration note for customers using pinned model names.

Nadia (Docs): will merge in ~5m unless any last concerns. Thanks!
